NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
2953-59 West Belmont Avenue
From C1-1 to B2-3

The Property
The property is located on the northwest corner of West Belmont Avenue and North Sacramento Avenue in an

C1-1 zoning district. The property is located in a Transit Served Location and is approximately 30.0 feet from the
Belmont Bus (Route 77) roadway segment. The subject property is improved with three frame buildings of various
heights.

The Project
The Applicant proposes to improve the property by constructing a five-story mixed-use building with 2,200 square

feet of ground floor commercial space, 24 residential dwelling units, 11 automobile parking spaces, and 24 bicycle
parking space. The zoning height of the building will be 61 feet 2 inches. To allow the proposed development, the
Applicant seeks a zoning change for the subject property from a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District to a
B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. As part of the rezoning, the Applicant also seeks all relief as needed, as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans, including: (1) a variation under 17-13-1101-A and
17-13-1003-EE to reduce the required automobile parking spaces from the required 24 spaces to 11 spaces; (2) a
variation under 17-13-1101-D to reduce the number of required loading berths from one to zero; (3) a variation
under 17-13-1101-B to reduce the rear-yard setback from the required 30 feet to 4 inches; (4) a variation under
17-13-1101-B to reduce the required setbacks of the elevator and stair penthouse/override per 17-17-0311-C(3).

17-3-0308 Specific Criteria for Transit Served Locations Requirements*
1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B:

RESPONSE: The project complies with Section 17-10-0102-B as the property is a Transit Served
Location within 1,320 feet of an applicable bus line corridor roadway Segment. The proposed
development does not include more than 50% of the otherwise required parking.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504, except paragraph H if the
project is not located along a pedestrian street and except paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-
commercial use group, pertaining to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not
located along a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street:

RESPONSE: The project is not located along a pedestrian street but complies with Section 17-3-0504

because:
Building Location; The front facades face W. Belmont Ave. and N. Sacramento Ave., and the design
complies with sections (1) and (2)(a)-(c), as the setbacks are no more than 5 feet, and the entrance
size is within the required parameters;

e Transparency: 60% of the fagades on W. Belmont Ave. and N. Sacramento Ave between 4 feet and
10 feet in height will be comprised of clear, non-reflective windows;

¢ Doors and Entrances: The building will have entrances on W. Belmont Ave. and N. Sacramento
Ave, and will be set back no more than 5 feet;

¢ Off-Street Parking: 11 on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided;

e Parking Location: On-site parking will be enclosed and in the rear; and;

e Driveways and Vehicle Access: The Applicant will provide access to the parking garage from the
rear alley;

* Section 17-3-0308 responses required per 17-3-0403-B Increase for Transit-Served Locations

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly Development Guide:
Station Area Typology, and any other station-specific plans, designs or guidelines adopted by the
Chicago Plan Commission:

RESPONSE: The property is not within 2,640 feet of CTA rail station entrance; however, it is nearest to
the Belmont Blue Line CTA Station. Under the Transit Friendly Guide, the typology for this station is
identified as an Urban Neighborhood (UN), which calls for new multifamily buildings and local retail
development next to transit—the proposed project provides both.

4. Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess of 50% of the Minimum
Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result
rounded up to the next higher whole number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as
an administrative adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE; and

RESPONSE: The project does not have automobile parking in excess of 50%. The Applicant is seeking
to reduce parking from 24 required to 11 spaces ( less than 50% ) under the provisions of 17-13-1003-EE.

5, The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules of the Chicago Department
of Transportation.
RESPONSE: The project will comply with applicable Travel Demand Study and Management Plan
rules promulgated by the Chicago Department of Transportation.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 9,150.55 sq. ft.

Floor Area: 36,500 sq. ft.

FAR: 4.00*

Residential Dwelling Units: 24

MLA Density: 381.27*

Height: 61 ft. 2 in.

Automobile Parking: 11

Bicycle Parking: 24

Setbacks:
Front (Belmont Ave) 4”
Side (East) 22
Side (West) 4
Rear (Alley) 4”

* The property qualifies for a FAR increase under 17-3-0403-B due to its status as a Transit- Served Location and
100% on-site ARO units. The property also qualifies for an MLA reduction under section 17-3-0402-B
